job: Compare, sort and act on records laid out in rows and columns.
purpose: A native table with a scrolling wrapper, sortable headers, optional row selection with a bulk bar, expandable and clickable rows, grouped rows under heading rows that can open and close, sticky headers, and skeleton, empty and error states. Numbers are right-aligned with tabular figures. Below 560px of container width a table with data-stack turns each row into a card.
useWhen: People compare the same fields across many records: logs, keys, invoices, runs.
Rows need sorting, selection, bulk actions or an actions cell.
The same records must stay readable on a phone (add data-stack).
Records fall into a few kinds that share columns (keys by environment, monitors by site): one table with a heading row per group.

avoidWhen.when: Records are few and each needs a title, a description and several controls.
The data is a handful of label and value pairs for one record.
The table is a grid of switches with a category column.
The numbers are a trend over time.

avoidWhen.instead: Use one table per group, each with its own heading.

states.name: loading
states.how: aria-busy="true" on the table, with tr[data-skeleton] rows holding fd-table-skeleton bars

states.name: empty
states.how: a tr.fd-table-state row with fd-table-empty, naming what will appear and the next step

states.name: error
states.how: a tr.fd-table-state row with fd-table-empty and a retry button

states.name: selected
states.how: data-select checkboxes; the bulk bar fd-table-bulk shows the count

states.name: sorted
states.how: aria-sort="ascending|descending" on the th that holds fd-th-sort

states.name: expanded
states.how: tr[data-expanded] followed by a tr.fd-table-detail row

states.name: group closed
states.how: data-state="closed" on a tbody.fd-table-group; its toggle has aria-expanded="false" and only the heading shows

states.name: group filtered out
states.how: every row of a group carries hidden; the group's heading hides too

variants.useWhen: The header stays while rows scroll inside a height set with --fd-table-max.
On a td or th: drop this column when the table stacks into cards.
On a th: the column shrinks to its content.
On a th: the column takes the remaining width.
On a td or th: a numeric column, right-aligned with tabular figures.
On a td: an identifier or endpoint in the mono face.
On the last td and th: row actions, quiet until the row is hovered or focused.
On a tr: the whole row opens a page; keep a real link in the row for keyboard and middle-click.
Groups open and close: data.js turns each group heading into a toggle button.

parts.role: Frame around the scroller and the foot; holds the bulk bar and the border.
Owns horizontal scrolling; edge fades show on the sides with more content.
The button inside a sortable th; its arrow shows direction.
Flex row inside a td: a leading tile and a two-line name.
The leading tile of a cell.
A title and a muted line stacked in one cell.
Truncates a long string such as a URL to a width set with --w.
The disclosure button of an expandable row.
The row that holds an expanded row's detail.
The single row that holds a loading, empty or error message.
The bar that slides up over the foot with the selection count and actions.
The foot under the table: count or summary on the left, pagination and actions on the right.
A tbody holding one group: its heading row, then its rows.
The group's heading row, a th scope="rowgroup" across the columns; no hover, never a link.
The group's name; it labels the tbody.
The number of rows in the group; data-auto keeps it to the rows shown.
The button in a heading that opens and closes the group (aria-expanded).

keyboard.does: Opens a row that carries data-href, or sorts the focused header.
On a group heading's toggle: opens or closes the group.
